title: IBM security advisory (AV26-1162)
description: As of November 13, 2026, IBM is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
App Connect Operator
	Prior to or equal to 12.0.28
Prior to or equal to 12.21.0
Prior to or equal to 13.6.0

ContextForge MCP Gateway
	Prior to or equal to 1.1.0

Security QRadar EDR
	Prior to or equal to 3.12.26

webMethods Integration Server
	Prior to or equal to 10.15_Core_Fix2
Prior to or equal to 11.1_Core_Fix11
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
